args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted.
Flagged (1): r05, because a check failed but the run was still accepted. Its closure value is 2.899, above the 1.0 threshold, even though the check is marked as passed. The run kept no remedy. Its REGR-peak z of -6.38 is only a 0.01 %/h difference on a batch MAD of 0, so it is not an outlier.
Cleared (7): r01, r02, r03, r04, r06, r07, r08. They pass rigid-body invariance, closure and plane sections. Every summary has |z| ≤ 1.06. The REGR peak is 53.1 %/h at 421 µm. The growth zone is 674–684 µm, and the flank difference peaks at 84 µm. Each kept one remedy with no roll-backs.
What the flagged run has in common: only r05 is flagged. The tip motion from the midline and stage log does not match the tip motion from the tracked velocity field. Its strain-rate profile looks like the rest of the batch, but that profile cannot be trusted while closure fails. The closure pass flag also needs fixing upstream, because it should not read passed when the value is over the threshold.
